name: @izakhono/pay
description: IZAKHONO PAY non-custodial payment orchestration, control plane and reconciliation portal

scripts.check: node --check src/core.js && node --check src/control-plane.js && node --check src/reconciliation.js && node --check src/merchant-webhooks.js && node --check src/index.js && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Direct deployment is disabled. Use the owner-controlled sandbox or production GitHub Actions workflow.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:sandbox: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.sandbox.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:production: node -e "console.error('Production migrations are restricted to the owner-controlled production workflow after D1 identity preflight.'); process.exit(1)"
